title: html2text文档归档工作场景
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：以显式模式让真实行内代码动态定界且保留原始正文；让实际表格caption成为独立可读段落且不污染首行表头；让图片组及图说明在真实输出中保持段落关系和图片配置；在真实图片转换中按明确像素密度选择离线srcset来源；以明确可见正文模式略去template及HTML隐藏子树并清理状态；提供不可变严格配置并在实际转换前校验类型范围及组合。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Add opt-in HTML2Text.adaptive_inline_code (default False), integrated into real code/kbd/tt tag/data handling. Buffer a single inline-code span, normalize line endings to spaces, choose a backtick delimiter strictly longer than any body run and apply CommonMark edge-backtick/double-ended-space padding so independent decoding restores the exact body. Ignore nested formatting markup while preserving its text/entities, handle multiple spans, empty spans and unclosed EOF without state leakage to later handle calls. Preserve default compatibility and pre paths. Do not merely escape source backticks or replace the entire document with a different converter.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/test/test_development_html2text_o01_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-html2text-o01-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Add image_density=None opt-in selection to actual img conversion, not a standalone unused parser. For finite positive nonbool numeric targets, parse unordered x-density srcset candidates (unmarked means 1x), select the smallest density >= target or largest available, and resolve through existing baseurl/link behavior.
